what: Things from upstream that must stay out of Ultron, whatever a new Mark brings. `needles` are regular expressions the check script looks for in the lines upstream adds or changes, so a change that touches an exclusion is named in the weekly report. `guard` says what keeps it out here: a test that exercises the behaviour, or a tripwire (a test that fails if any needle appears in Ultron's own code). Add an exclusion only with the owner's word.

exclusions.name: News on open
exclusions.rule: Nothing fetches or says the news when Ultron opens unless the owner saved the morning brief on. A missing or malformed setting means off.
exclusions.decided: DECISIONS.md, 'Startup morning brief is opt-in'; confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-22

exclusions.name: News watch every 30 minutes
exclusions.rule: No routine speaks news headlines on a timer. Ultron's own topic monitor, which speaks only for topics the owner asked it to follow, is unchanged.

exclusions.name: Startup routines that run tools
exclusions.rule: Nothing runs an instruction with tools by itself when Ultron opens.

exclusions.name: Phone and web remote dashboard
exclusions.rule: Nothing in Ultron serves a page, pairs a phone or takes commands from a phone or a browser: no dashboard server, no pairing key, no certificate, no firewall rule, no phone-microphone relay. A tripwire reads Ultron's own code for the dashboard's names; it cannot notice a new server under another name.
exclusions.decided: owner, 2026-11-26 ("Remove the dashboard for phone and web remote."); DECISIONS.md, the row of that date
